definitions.explanation: An organization recognized by law as having its own legal rights and obligations, such as a company, foundation, or association. Contrasted with {個人|こじん} (individual/natural person).

examples.japanese: {法人|ほうじん}を{設立|せつりつ}した。
{法人税|ほうじんぜい}の{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げが{検討|けんとう}されている。
examples.english: A reduction in corporate tax is being considered.

examples.japanese: この{口座|こうざ}は{法人|ほうじん}{向|む}けで、{個人|こじん}ではお{申|もう}し{込|こ}みできません。
examples.english: This account is for corporations; individuals cannot apply.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and business term. Frequently used as a modifier: {法人|ほうじん}{税|ぜい} (corporate tax), {法人|ほうじん}{向|む}け (for corporations), {法人|ほうじん}{名|めい} (corporate name). Often contrasted with {個人|こじん} (individual).

Types of {法人|ほうじん} include {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ} (stock corporation), NPO{法人|ほうじん} (NPO), and {社団法人|しゃだんほうじん} (incorporated association).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法人税|ほうじんぜい}: corporate tax
- {法人|ほうじん}{向|む}け: for corporate clients
- {法人|ほうじん}{名|めい}: corporate name
- {法人|ほうじん}を{設立|せつりつ}する: to establish a corporation
- NPO{法人|ほうじん}: NPO (nonprofit organization)
